verdict.rationale: The evidence documents the Dataverse Web API and its operations (queries, batch requests, deep inserts) as static reference material. Nothing shows an interactive API explorer or runnable 'try it' examples, and the OpenAPI probe paths all returned 404. Static reference docs are adjacent to this story but are not the interactive, runnable capability it asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
